title: Fishing Gear Entangles 100,000 Marine Animals A Year
hook: Abandoned fishing gear keeps killing after crews leave.
closing: Removing abandoned gear stops plastic from continuing to fish without people.
question: Should gear retrieval be mandatory?

segments.say: Fishing gear makes up 10% of ocean litter. Its danger continues after abandonment.
Lost fishing gear totals 640,000 metric tons yearly. Working equipment becomes a massive waste stream.
Fishing gear entangles 100,000 marine animals yearly. The damage continues long after crews leave.
